purpose: Exploratory paired MAG/PHA versus MAG/PHA plus one local three-dimensional trajectory bottleneck objective; no website publication
success_scope: No universal claim from four paired seeds. Primary uses identical MAG/PHA-only selection in both arms. Secondary explicitly permits limited MAG/PHA tradeoff. Training geometry is a discrete sampled score; independently refine and expose sampling instability, never relax tolerances to pass.
held_out_policy: All four targets are development examples, not unseen validation circuits. No parameter tuning after looking at pilot results.
